newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE SUGAR FIRMS, NERVOUS IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE SUGAR FIRMS, NERVOUS IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: LIFFE sugar firmed in low volume in morning trade.
"The market's still nervous," one trader said. "It's waiting to see what's going to happen in New York."
Unless New York shows strong direction, it would take new fundamental news to move the market out of its current torpor, he said. "Unfortunately fresh physical news is thin on the ground," he said.
By 1143 GMT, October was 60 cents higher at $322.90. Volume on October was 428 of the total 473 lots. The trader pointed out that the volume was inflated by 280 lots of against actuals trades.
